answer: Admit new agents through a single metered inlet: each epoch only a fixed number of entry slots open, auctioned for a bond that is refunded after ten epochs of attested work. A raven-style auditor, picked by the epoch seed, re-runs a sample of each newcomer's tasks; failures burn the bond. Like yarrow spreading one root at a time, a sybil farm can only grow as fast as the inlet allows, and every clone costs a locked bond.
